#
# Common disallows for each technology
# Some repeated folders are ignored as rules follow each other
#

# PHP disallows
User-agent: *
Disallow: /config/
Disallow: /includes/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /cache/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /logs/
# Node.JS disallows
Disallow: /node_modules/
Disallow: /database/
Disallow: /bin/
# HTML disallows
Disallow: /assets/
Disallow: /scripts/
Disallow: /styles/
Disallow: /backup/
Disallow: /temp/
# Wordpress core files disallows
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Disallow: /wp-includes/
Disallow: /wp-content/plugins/
Disallow: /wp-content/cache/
Disallow: /cgi-bin/

# Bot agents management
#

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

Disallow: /

Disallow: /
